text: You just started choking, and you're home alone. Here's what you do.
If you can't talk, cough, or breathe, your airway is blocked.
Without air, your brain can start getting hurt in about four minutes.
Call 911 first. Then make a fist just above your belly button.
Grab it with your other hand, lean over a chair, and push hard, in and up.
Keep going until the food pops out.
Don't stick your fingers in your throat. It can push it deeper.
